latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Real Estate Lead Machine.
- Automates scraping of new and motivated property listings from major portals (Zillow, Rightmove, etc.) with owner/agent contact extraction.
- Ranks leads by motivation level, opportunity score, and market analysis.
- Generates AI-personalized outreach (email/SMS/follow-ups) for each lead.
- Delivers a unified, ranked lead list with contact data and outreach messages, exportable in CSV/JSON.
- Designed for agents, investors, and property sourcers to contact sellers before competitors.
